purpose: Teach: 下地/吉村/日野/松原/三田/岩崎/山岡/稲葉

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の下地部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our new department head, Shimoji, to the company.
lines.style: Formal, measured opening. Clear enunciation on each directive. Authoritative but not harsh—the practiced voice of someone accustomed to being obeyed without needing to raise volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の吉村課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the travel schedule for Sales Manager Yoshimura.
lines.style: Prompt, efficient affirmation. Quick intake of breath before speaking—ready to move to the next task. Respectful without servility. The tone of someone competent at executing orders.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の日野主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the project to Hino, our technical lead.
lines.style: Direct command, steady pace. Slight pause before the name—giving it weight. Not unkind, but there's no room for negotiation in the phrasing. The voice of someone used to delegating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の松原様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll have PR Director Matsubara's strategy approved and implemented.
lines.style: Brisk confirmation. The 'understood' lands quickly, then a slight momentum shift into the action items. Professional efficiency without flatness. The cadence of someone keeping multiple threads organized.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、東京三田の支店を整理しろ
lines.en: Streamline our Mita branch in Tokyo.
lines.style: Flat, businesslike delivery. No inflection to soften the instruction. The brevity suggests this is a decision already made. Steady eye contact implied in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の岩崎ご令孫を式典にお招きします
lines.en: Understood. I'll extend an invitation to Iwasaki, the founder's grandson, for the ceremony.
lines.style: Formal acknowledgment. Careful enunciation around the family name and title—showing respect to the lineage being referenced. Still efficient, but with a touch more ceremonial care than the previous responses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の山岡常務にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Delegate the project to Yamaoka, our new Managing Director.
lines.style: Clear, unhurried command. The title lands with slight emphasis—establishing hierarchy. Not rushed, but definitive. The tone of someone confident in the person being named.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の稲葉様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request that Legal Director Inaba review and confirm the contracts.
lines.style: Final affirmation with a touch of closure. Slightly slower pace on the details—legal matters warrant precision. Calm, thorough, the sound of someone wrapping up a list of orders with the same professionalism they opened with.
